body:
CURRENT (rev 4, Fable2 #5847 2026-11-13 06:54Z, superseding #5842/#5844): the binding-drop path for closure items is WITHDRAWN (Kimi::Consultant objected, #235; dropping a test binding is a waiver needing Greg, not remote equivalence). Landed items whose full-gate criterion is test-bound (e105, aa7b, w-70ed so far) restore their ORIGINAL bindings, request NO evaluation, and PARK until Engram's remote_verification_record association (w-180d6f507470) can credit the existing landing FULL. No closure FULL reruns on Central just for credit; they stay dequeued. Opus2's own combo items are unaffected (their C2 was never test-bound), but their C3 install needs the coordinated all-host restart before evaluation.
Placement rules from Fable2 #5846 that still stand: AUTHOR checks go to DL560 first, focused or FULL (rule 7); Central only for Windows-only code or a Windows leg the item requires. A NEW closure Test stays a registered Central run (no general move to DL560). Starvation guard: while a cold Central run waits for 24 GiB, a ready WARM (same root, same commit), UI-only or no-cargo run may take the slot only if expected to finish within about 15 min; once the cold run has waited 30 min, nothing new backfills until it starts. Greg's Chrome on Central is not ours to budget; don't ask.
Earlier history (Greg's "Tak. Zdalny test jest równowazny.", the dequeue at 06:50Z) is in revisions 2-3.
